## Install

| System                                           | File                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ |
| macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon and Intel)              | `trusquin-macos-universal.zip`             |
| Windows 11 (x64)                                 | `trusquin-amd64-installer.exe`             |
| Ubuntu 24.04+, Pop!\_OS 24.04+, Debian 13+ (x64) | `.deb` (`sudo apt install ./trusquin.deb`) |

Trusquin is not signed by Apple or Microsoft yet, so your system warns you on first launch:

- **macOS**: unzip, move `trusquin.app` to Applications and open it. When macOS refuses, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows**: on the "Windows protected your PC" screen, click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux**: Ubuntu 22.04 and Debian 12 are not supported (GTK too old).

The interface is in English or French, following your system language.
